propositions: git commit --amend -m/-F replaces the entire commit message and drops the Change-Id trailer, causing Gerrit to stamp a fresh Change-Id and create a duplicate change instead of a new patchset
Git's prepare-commit-msg hook cannot distinguish an amend with -F from a fresh commit with -F (both receive source='message' sha=''), so hook-based prevention is infeasible

A make amend-msg FILE=<path> wrapper must extract the existing Change-Id from HEAD, rewrite the message from FILE while preserving that Change-Id via git interpret-trailers, and fail loudly if HEAD has no Change-Id
The wrapper must be documented in AGENTS.md as the required path for rewriting a commit message, with explicit warning that --amend -m/-F drop Change-Id and create orphaned duplicate changes
Tests must prove the wrapper preserves Change-Id identity across amend, the naive form changes it, and missing Change-Id causes loud non-zero failure with HEAD untouched
